about: Neuausrichtung 1 / P3 (docs/v2/NEU1-wecken.md); read by dfpilot (session.config), a missing file or a bad key = the default shown here. wait: act = `dfllm wait` returns on every class-A event (not only the FR-53 interrupts) except quiet_types and DECISION_NEEDED ids in quiet_decisions (unknown types and ids wake: fail closed), plus DEADMAN (the kernel paused: no live session), FOLLOW_OFF (follow does not beat) and KERNEL_STALE (kernel heartbeat older than kernel_stale_s); false = the old interrupts-only wait. One key (type, decision id) wakes at most once per repeat_s real seconds; a cursor (<save>/.wait.json) more than backlog events behind starts at the end of the log. follow_check = the FOLLOW_OFF reason. session: on = wait, brief, cmd, ack, plan and next write <save>/session.json, the heartbeat the kernel's dead-man switch (config/reflex.json deadman) reads; DFLLM_NO_SESSION=1 suppresses it per process. follow: restart = a follow whose working set passes max_rss_mb MB or that ran max_hours hours starts a copy of itself (--takeover, same output) and exits.
